question: R is the father of a girl S and brother of a man A. C is mother of S and sister-in-law of A. What is relationship between S and A?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) R is the father of a girl S and brother of a man A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eab55b08cdd82001c8f68205ca617ea096a09bb235e2b4e52d56f8e80b3dcb8.png] 

2) C is mother of S and sister-in-law of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2de458af21e8648b76b394166f8b804030367c9677fc64aed3bb4c5b518b012.png] 

Thus, S is the niece of A and A is the paternal uncle of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
